sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety. Duplicate hits in the same table were MCPZoo, Agent Hacks Agent, AgentFootprint, and PUST; selected non-duplicate TerraRepair.
Read arXiv HTML full text and replication package README; extracted method, tables, metrics, ablations, escalation taxonomy, and limitations.
Explained bounded ReAct repair loop, graph_query, schema_lookup, scanner_run, claimed-vs-verified gap, and reproduction scripts.
Separated scanner-verified evidence from semantic correctness, deployment validity, and independent cloud-security review.
Positioned TerraRepair against automatic program repair, LLM vulnerability repair, IaC generation, and configuration-security remediation.
Markdown uses TL;DR, h3-style sections, tables, formula block, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no external image URLs were embedded.
